info.title: BPS looker read API
info.description: Read-only access to the crawled BPS data (labeled `v_*` views).

get.description: 200 with the DB's Alembic revision, or 503 when the database can't be reached.
Every crawled domain, ordered by ``domain_id``; ``level`` filters pusat/prov/kab.

Full-text search ranked by relevance (title over subject), or all by title when ``q`` is
empty; ``total`` counts every match.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Words to find in the title or subject (all must match, each as a prefix: `infl bul`). Empty → every variable, by title.
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Words to find in the title or subject (all must match, each as a prefix: `infl bul`). Empty → every variable, by title.

get.description:
Title, unit, subject, definition/notes (BPS HTML — sanitize before rendering), decimals,
last update, plus every dimension member: vervar (regions/categories), turvar, turth
(sub-periods with their ``freq`` and ``has_data``) and periods (``th`` = year).

get.summary: Time series of a variable, one per vervar x turvar
get.description:
One series per vervar x turvar combination (request order), at most ``max_series``
(``truncated`` when more were asked for); points sorted by time, each with its period
(``2024-03``, ``2024-Q2``, ``2024-S1``, ``2024``) and start date.

parameters.name: vervar

schema.description: Vervar members (repeat the parameter); default: all.
schema.title: Vervar

parameters.description: Vervar members (repeat the parameter); default: all.

parameters.name: turvar

schema.description: Turvar members (repeat the parameter); default: all.
schema.title: Turvar

parameters.description: Turvar members (repeat the parameter); default: all.

parameters.name: turth

schema.description: Only these sub-periods, e.g. months `1`-`12`; default: all.
schema.title: Turth

parameters.description: Only these sub-periods, e.g. months `1`-`12`; default: all.

get.summary: One value per region for one period (ranking + map)
get.description:
Every vervar member's value for one (``th``, ``turth``) period — by default the latest
with data (for ``turvar`` and ``freq``) — sorted by value, highest first (members without a
value last, ``null``). The national aggregate (9999 / ``INDONESIA``) comes as ``national``,
not ranked. ``periods`` lists every period with data, in time order, for a slider.

parameters.name: turth

schema.description: Sub-period; default: the latest of the year.
schema.title: Turth

parameters.description: Sub-period; default: the latest of the year.

parameters.name: freq

schema.description: Only periods of this kind (slider + default).
schema.title: Freq

parameters.description: Only periods of this kind (slider + default).

get.summary: Latest strategic indicators of a domain, with change vs the previous periode
get.description:
Every indicator's latest snapshot (``v_indicator_latest``) plus the previous periode's
value and the change (``null`` when unknown); ``variable`` links to the Explorer when the
underlying variable is crawled. A known domain without indicators → empty ``items``.

get.summary: Every recorded periode of one strategic indicator
get.description:
The latest snapshot (as in ``GET /indicators``) plus one point per periode seen by the
crawler, oldest first (sighting order: ``periode`` is free text).

parameters.name: indicator_id

schema.description: BPS indicator id within the domain.
schema.title: Indicator Id

parameters.description: BPS indicator id within the domain.

get.summary: Years and months with trade data, per flow
get.description:
Every (flow, year) with data: whether BPS annual figures exist and which months have
monthly figures; plus the latest year and month (dashboard defaults).

get.summary: Total exports / imports (value, net weight) and the trade balance
get.description:
Totals over one period (`year`, `year`+`month`) or a range (`from`/`to`); nothing given →
the latest year with data. A year counts its annual figures, or — without them — the sum
of its monthly figures (year to date); `periods` says which, per year.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: Range start: `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`. Two years → whole years (annual figures, else the sum of the year's months); otherwise months. One of `from`/`to` alone means both.
schema.title: From

parameters.description: Range start: `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`. Two years → whole years (annual figures, else the sum of the year's months); otherwise months. One of `from`/`to` alone means both.

get.summary: Top N countries, ports or HS chapters by value, plus an others bucket
get.description:
The flow's value and net weight per chapter / country / port over the range (default:
the latest year with data), largest first; the rest summed into `others`. Chapters are
labelled with their HS description.

parameters.name: by

schema.description: Group by HS chapter, country or port.
schema.title: By

parameters.description: Group by HS chapter, country or port.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: Range start: `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`. Two years → whole years (annual figures, else the sum of the year's months); otherwise months. One of `from`/`to` alone means both.
schema.title: From

parameters.description: Range start: `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`. Two years → whole years (annual figures, else the sum of the year's months); otherwise months. One of `from`/`to` alone means both.

get.summary: Monthly trade values, optionally for one HS chapter and/or country
get.description:
One series of monthly figures per flow (default: all months with data), and with both
flows the monthly balance (exports - imports) where both have data.

parameters.name: country

schema.description: Country name as BPS writes it.
schema.title: Country

parameters.description: Country name as BPS writes it.

parameters.name: flow

schema.description: One flow; default: both, plus the trade balance.
schema.title: Flow

parameters.description: One flow; default: both, plus the trade balance.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: Range start: `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`. Two years → whole years (annual figures, else the sum of the year's months); otherwise months. One of `from`/`to` alone means both.
schema.title: From

parameters.description: Range start: `YYYY` or `YYYY-MM`. Two years → whole years (annual figures, else the sum of the year's months); otherwise months. One of `from`/`to` alone means both.

CrossSection.title: CrossSection
CrossSection.description: Every vervar member's value for one period: ranking + map.

Indicator.title: Indicator
Indicator.description:
A strategic indicator's latest snapshot (``v_indicator_latest``) and its change vs the
previous periode (periodes are ordered by when they were seen — see ``api/indicators.py``).

TradeOthers.title: TradeOthers
TradeOthers.description: Everything below the top N, as one bucket.

TradeRange.title: TradeRange
TradeRange.description:
The resolved period range: ``year`` granularity (``2024``…``2025``) or ``month``
(``2024-11``…``2025-02``).

TradeYear.title: TradeYear
TradeYear.description: Trade data available for one flow and year.

TradeYearBasis.title: TradeYearBasis
TradeYearBasis.description:
How a year of the range was counted: its ``annual`` rows, or the sum of its ``monthly``
rows (a partial year when ``months`` < 12).

TurthMember.title: TurthMember
TurthMember.description: A sub-period member (month, quarter, …, or the annual total).

VariableDetail.title: VariableDetail
VariableDetail.description:
A variable's metadata and dimensions. ``definition``/``notes`` are BPS HTML: sanitize
before rendering.

VariableRef.title: VariableRef
VariableRef.description: A crawled dynamic-table variable (link target in the Explorer).

VariableSummary.title: VariableSummary
VariableSummary.description: A dynamic-table variable as listed by search (no definition/notes — see U3 detail).

VervarMember.title: VervarMember
VervarMember.description: A vertical-variable member (usually a region or a category).
